title: American-Style Buttermilk Fritters
description: Crispy, sweet buttermilk fritters made with a classic American twist. Perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together buttermilk, eggs, and vegetable oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the batter into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Drain the fritters on paper towels.
